user.title: Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB)
user.description: Enter your 10-digit CEB Electricity Account Number to track your bill balance.

data_description.kwh_entity: Entity providing electricity consumption in kWh (e.g. utility meter or energy sensor) for bill calculation.
data_description.billing_day: Day of the month your CEB meter is read and your billing cycle resets (1 - 31).
data_description.is_cumulative: Enable if the selected kWh entity accumulates total lifetime energy (e.g. solar inverter grid import). Current cycle consumption is calculated starting from your billing day using Home Assistant statistics. Disable if the entity already resets each cycle (e.g. monthly utility meter) or is a manual input.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to CEB InstantPay portal. Please verify internet connection or check if portal is reachable.
error.invalid_account_number: Invalid account number. CEB account numbers must be exactly 10 digits.

abort.already_configured: This CEB account is already configured.
